advisor.method: A floor: transcripts the host has deleted are missing; compressed .zst transcripts are read. One row per unique message id and request id. Weighted at full input price, cache read at 0.05.
advisor.source: advisor_message rows in usage.iterations of Claude transcripts still on disk

commits.method: UTC author date; outside authors out; commits_landed = non-merge on main/master, copies of one change collapsed; commits_all_refs = every commit on a branch, remote or tag, merges included; private repos fold into Other private work

tokens.method: Claude weighted = input + cache write + output + cache read x 0.05. Subagent = sidechain transcripts. unattributed = Claude tokens in the daily table that the per-model files lack: recovered days (totals only) and a few measured days where the per-model files are short (23 to 30 Sep 2026). Codex own tokens, parent history not counted. Advisor (source=advisor) is included in every Claude total.
tokens.source: usage-audit per-model csvs (Claude), Codex session logs, daily table

trading_bot.method: One window = 7,200 blocks (about one day) after the first. Net = value change of every token the bot moved, priced 5 minutes after each trade, day trend removed, minus builder tips and gas of the bot and of the firm's other contracts. Ranges: bootstrap of days (100,000 resamples, seed 1).
trading_bot.source: scripts/data/trading_bot_export.py (reads the private research onchain sweep)

weekly_limit.method: Integer percent used of the weekly limit, all models and Fable. Pace = percent used / share of the week elapsed at sampled_at.
weekly_limit.source: claude -p /usage, one sample a day (sampled_at is blank before 24 Nov 2026)
